info.description:
Description:
This course provides an introduction to visual communication design for students and provides them with the knowledge and skills to communicate their ideas and processes in a visual form more effectively. As a means of questioning and applying fundamental theories, concepts, and techniques, students produce visually meaningful projects. The course examines the basic elements of visual communication and how context shapes visual forms production and reception. Students will also learn to analyze the attention-getting qualities of form that engage people in compelling interactions.
Teaching methods used include: Lectures, Tutorials, Discussions, Laboratory work, Group work, and Seminars to help students approach the subject, understand the subject, apply it to practice, create compositions that communicate effectively by applying knowledge of interaction, interpretation, and experience, and analyze and evaluate design solutions in specific cultural and technical contexts.
info.studentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
2. Actively participate in class activities
3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
5. Read the textbook in advance
6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/gui/Home) for up-to-date information and material of the course.
7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher after the course.
info.tools:
Individual tools prepared by students:
- 1 folder (size A2).
- Paper (size A2, A3, A4), A1 backboard paper.
- Collecting newspaper, magazine having color photos.
- Color, pencil, eraser, brushes, back ink pen.
- Ruler, paper knife, scissors, paper sticking-plaster, double sized tape, glue.
- Laptop
- Digital graphic design tools
- Suitable Generative AI tools
- Video recording equipment

materials.materialDescription: Visual Communication from Theory to Practice
materials.author: Jonathan Baldwin, Lucienne Roberts

clos.loDetails: Explain the way people communicate visually, and how communication design organizes experience in a variety of structures.
Apply knowledge to arrange the elements - words, images and/or symbols that contribute to the construction of meaning, utilizing tools such as traditional tools, digitals tools, or generative AI.

Analyze the attention-getting qualities of form, which constitute an essential first step to appropriate interpretive behaviors, engage people in compelling interactions, and extend meaning beyond the momentary encounter with the message.
Create a composition that communicates and provides information about relevant interactions among the components of a message by applying knowledge of interaction, interpretation, and experience.
Create visual communication design solutions for specific cultural and digital contexts by applying manual and/or digital methods of retaining and extending meaning.
Have a positive attitude and a professional working style.
